findings.summary: Not run: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts`. The file does not exist on the current tree (checked with ls), so the capability-wide e2e check is still unwritten. It is owned by integration and is not part of this unit's Done when.

Not run: the Play dev-link walkthrough (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta; save a PNG logo and a JPG logo in Configurações -> Seus relatórios; export the three PDFs; check cover and footer). It needs the AIOSON Play desktop app, which this environment cannot run.

Not run: plain `pnpm typecheck` (the exact Done-when command). Running it can start pnpm's deps check, which runs `pnpm install` and a postinstall `prisma migrate deploy` that fails with 'database is locked' on data/fitpulse.db while a preview holds it. An accidental pnpm exec in this session reproduced that failure (exit 1), so the plain command was not rerun. The verified equivalent is `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, exit 0). Environmental; a fix belongs in package.json or the preview lifecycle, not in this unit.
